messages.subject: Planned maintenance: iManage DMS unavailable Sat 24 May 06:00–10:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

The document management system (iManage) will be unavailable this Saturday 24 May between 06:00 and 10:00 for a scheduled upgrade. Please check in any documents you are working on before Friday evening. Email and the time-recording system are unaffected.

Thank you,
IT Service Desk

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
DX 138760 Cheapside | +44 (0)20 7946 0991
www.whitfieldcarter.com
